# Extended Experiment: Official Kolkata Data, 2018-2026

*Generated by `python main.py extended` on 2026-11-13 00:49 (36.1 min on `cuda`). All numbers come from this run.*

**Result:** the model chosen on validation, **GRU** with `pollution+weather` inputs, scored test MAE **11.8** vs persistence 13.8: difference -2.0 [-3.2, -0.7], better than persistence.

## Data

| source | what | handling |
|---|---|---|
| Target | CPCB city AQI, daily 4 PM bulletin (`data/raw/cpcb/city_aqi/`) | 4 days without AQI are never used as targets |
| Pollutants | 7 WBPCB stations, CPCB CAAQMS 24-hour files (`data/raw/cpcb/stations/`) | daily mean over the stations reporting; gaps up to 7 days carried forward and flagged |
| Weather | Open-Meteo daily, 12 variables (`data/external/kolkata_weather_2018_2026.csv`) | complete; boundary layer height left out (missing Jan-Jun 2024) |
| Fires | NASA FIRMS VIIRS S-NPP (`data/interim/firms_daily_2018_2026.csv`) | vegetation fires, low confidence dropped; log count within 300 km, log power in region |
| Calendar | day of year; Kali Puja, Durga Puja, Holi, New Year; 2020 lockdown | flags describe the forecast day (known in advance) |

Days: 2953 (2018-10-01 to 2026-10-31). Split by date: train to 2023-12-31 (1918 days), validation 2024 (366), test from 2025-01-01 (669).

Yearly mean official AQI: 2018: 246, 2019: 136, 2020: 111, 2021: 124, 2022: 113, 2023: 105, 2024: 101, 2025: 99, 2026: 84.

## Forecast ranges (quantile attention LSTM, `pollution`)

The 80% range (10th to 90th percentile) contained the actual AQI on **92%** of test days; mean width 47 AQI points.

| alert rule | alerts | correct | false alarms | missed | precision | recall | F1 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Persistence > 200 | 41 | 24 | 17 | 17 | 0.585 | 0.585 | 0.585 |
| median > 200 | 44 | 29 | 15 | 12 | 0.659 | 0.707 | 0.682 |
| upper (90th pct) > 200 | 119 | 41 | 78 | 0 | 0.345 | 1.000 | 0.512 |

## What the attention LSTM looks at

Most weight: 1 day(s) before (7.3%), 2 day(s) before (7.3%), 3 day(s) before (7.2%); equal weighting would be 7.1% per day.

## How to read these results honestly

- One chronological split. The test period (2025-2026) is cleaner air than most training years.
- City pollutant inputs are the mean of the stations reporting each day; only 2 stations ran in 2018.
- Weather is reanalysis, fires are satellite detections; associations, not causes.
- Festival dates come from public calendars.
